svg.title: Expected nap timeline with algorithm parameters
svg.desc: HR trajectory over a typical nap session, showing the four algorithm phases, awake and light reference values, and the trigger thresholds for onset detection and deepening detection. The wake decision fires around minute 23 when rolling HR drops 5 bpm below the light reference and sustains for 90 seconds total.
svg.text: Deepening trigger also requires rolling SD ≤ 0.8 bpm sustained 90s (not shown)
